name: HAVØK Command Center
install: bash -c 'for p in .cursor/install.sh repos/braxx-admin/.cursor/install.sh /agent/repos/braxx-admin/.cursor/install.sh; do [ -f "$p" ] && exec bash "$p"; done; echo "install.sh not found from $PWD" >&2; exit 1'
start: bash -c 'for p in .cursor/start.sh repos/braxx-admin/.cursor/start.sh /agent/repos/braxx-admin/.cursor/start.sh; do [ -f "$p" ] && exec bash "$p"; done; echo "start.sh not found from $PWD" >&2; exit 1'

terminals.name: dev
terminals.command: for d in . repos/braxx-admin /agent/repos/braxx-admin; do [ -f "$d/package.json" ] && cd "$d" && break; done; npm run dev
